news.title: India loses to Afghanistan in FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival in Baku
news.lede: BAKU India lost 1-2 to Afghanistan in the quarterfinals for positions 81 to 88 in the FIFA Under-15 World Cup & Festival at the Hovsan Competition Complex Pitch 1A in Baku on Thursday. The Blue Colts will now face Kazakhstan, which lost to Hungary, in the semifinals for positions 85 to 88 later in the day. Afghanistan opened the scoring against the run of play through Mohammad Mustafa (15’) before Shahzada Sultani (27’) doubled the side’s advantage. Nibas Meetei Wahengbam (36’) reduced the deficit, but the Blue Colts could not find an equaliser.

news.title: Blue Colts' FIFA U15 World Cup Journey Ends In Quarter-Final Loss
news.lede: India's U15 football team faced a tough 1-2 defeat against Afghanistan in the FIFA U15 World Cup quarter-finals, ending their hopes for a higher placement. India lost 1-2 to Afghanistan in the quarter-finals for positions 81 to 88 in the FIFA U15 World Cup and Festival in Baku on Thursday. The Blue Colts will face Kazakhstan, who lost to Hungary, in the semi-finals for positions 85 to 88 later on Thursday. Afghanistan opened the scoring against the run of play through Mohammad Mustafa (15') before Shahzada Sultani (27') doubled their advantage.
